mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals the start of a monetary easing cycle, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: sharp rise in federal funds rate
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in rate hikes are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) over 3 consecutive months reduces consumer purchasing power and corporate hiring intentions, lowering expected equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in benefit increases are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) over 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, increasing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which raises expected equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in benefit cuts are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over 3 consecutive months indicates weakening domestic demand or supply constraints, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weak production are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening economy and rising demand, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strong production are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
